decisions.reason: It already has a publicly cited customer-saving result and fits the firm's announced modular environmental-technology path, so recent investment and visible commitment make withdrawal very unlikely.

A dedicated product page signals a clear public commitment and, as a close extension of the core range in a growing firm and industry, management is likely to continue backing it despite limited early evidence.

Although market proof is still weak, it builds on the established offer and the firm has R&D resources, growth momentum and strategic commitment to modular solutions, which favors continued support rather than an early reversal.

As a close-to-core machine in a growing machinery business, it is likely to be retained because sunk development and launch effort can still be justified as needing more time, even if website evidence is limited so far.
